topics.purpose: Define schema-validated Routine input parameters, defaults, required values and explicit binding into step arguments without hidden context injection.

semantics.parameter_rule: Every parameter has explicit identity/name/type/schema semantics.
semantics.default_rule: Defaults are explicit inert values and never hidden environment-dependent behavior.
semantics.context_rule: Runtime/session/context values may be referenced only through declared context bindings.
semantics.validation_rule: Routine invocation validates inputs before Runner creation/step dispatch.
semantics.secret_rule: Secret parameter handling/redaction follows explicit policy and is never embedded in ordinary execution traces.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown supplied parameters fail or follow explicit extension policy.

invariants.rule: Routine definitions are explicit canonical ordered compositions of exact commands/operations/routines; runtime execution state is never embedded into the reusable definition.

hard_gates.condition: hidden ambient context injected into parameter
unknown parameter silently accepted with new meaning
